terra.problem: Saying the young man's problem isn't nerve goes beyond the text. It says he lacks judgment, not whether he lacks courage.
Saying the line is built to make him feel special assigns the woman a purpose the text does not state.
A full moon is not necessarily a long way off from twilight. The passage does not say how long it is until the full moon.
Saying a week is a little off assumes how long it is until the full moon. The passage does not give that interval.
The woman mentions a bag of money, not coins. The passage does not specify what form the money takes.
The verse warns about both the heart and the paths; it does not say the heart turns before the feet move.
The passage does not say why the father states the warning plainly. Marking the reason as a guess does not make it a stated reason.
The passage does not say why the father does not soften the line. Marking the reason as a guess does not make it a stated reason.
The passage says the road descends to the chambers of death; it does not state that there is no feasting there.
